text:
ryn: quick idea — run a small UX experiment: compact 'slab rollup' card that shows amortized slab savings vs marginal per-invocation cost. toggle on the card to switch views.
jamie: ooh nice. main ask: can the card be computed from existing sessionized telemetry or do we need new signals?
sasha: we have session_id, model_sku, route, cache_hit boolean already in telemetry. the tricky part is attributing shared prefetch/pinned-slab savings across sessions.
mike: agree. sampling also complicates it. if sample_rate=0.1 our amortized numbers will be noisy for small tenants. how do we show confidence?
ranika: show a small CI or a "sampled" badge + absolute sample count. UX: greyed-out low-confidence numbers and tooltip explaining sampling.
ryn: for the first pass let's only show the card for tenants with > 1k invocations/day or sampled_count > 1000. fallback to "insufficient data" otherwise.
jamie: implementation sketch: compute per-epoch slab allocation on ingest job, emit slab_credited_per_invocation metric by session. then dashboard rolls up per-route/per-model. pseudocode:
```
-- ingest job
group by slab_id, epoch
compute slab_cost_per_sec, total_prefetch_tokens
assign credit = slab_cost_per_sec * usage_seconds_per_session / total_usage_seconds
emit metric: slab_credit_per_invocation
```
Use existing metrics pipeline, no new tracing required.
sasha: careful: some prefetches are shared across routes (global prefetch). we need originator route tag to avoid double crediting. add origin_route label to the slab record.
mike: also need quota interactions: if route A uses prefetch for route B, credits should flow to route A (owner) but show "beneficiary" breakdown in expanded view. UX: small stacked bar on hover.
ranika: expansion idea: default compact card shows two numbers: "amortized unit cost" and "marginal unit cost" with delta and arrows. clicking expands to a per-model breakdown + beneficiary view.
ryn: rollout plan: A/B launch to internal beta tenants (10 tenants) for 2 weeks, collect feedback and telemetry. toggle behind feature flag `ui.cost.slab_rollup_v1`.
jamie: telemetry: add two new metrics to make offline debug easier: `slab_credits_emitted` (counter) and `slab_crediting_reason` (tag: origin_route|beneficiary|shared). these are lightweight.
sasha: performance note: computing amortized credits at high cardinality could be heavy. we should pre-aggregate by epoch+slab_id daily and store a compact mapping service instead of recomputing on the fly.
mike: agree. storage proto: small key (slab_id, epoch) -> {total_seconds, total_tokens, origin_route}. keep in hot cache for last 7 days.
ryn: QA checklist: verify sampling propagation, verify sticky-routing cases where cached KV is reused across sessions, check canary against billing model to ensure numbers don't diverge > 5%.
ananika: minor nit: spelling — it's anika not ananika ;). also can we add an access control: only owners & infra can expand beneficiary view?
jamie: yes, map to existing billing/admin perms.
deploy-bot: snapshot saved for feature-flag `ui.cost.slab_rollup_v1` (canary build #842) :white_check_mark:
sasha: next steps: jamie to draft query backfills and pre-aggregate job; mike to design cache for epoch-slab mapping; ran to mock UI comps (compact + expanded). I'll schedule a 30m sync tomorrow.
ryn: perfect — thanks all. small goal: get internal beta out by end of next sprint. :rocket:
